title: cli: a flag missing its value (`os dev -d`) exits 2 without the INVOCATION ERROR banner, so a backgrounded boot looks like one that died
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZpHPpovxXPremPLtv

立卡门: ① 产品缺陷，具名落点 + 复现（reach: 公开入口 CLI `os dev -d` 实测一次错误结果）
业务理由: 在后台启动 `os dev` 的用户和 agent 依赖 #10181 的 INVOCATION ERROR 首行，来分辨「命令根本没跑」和「应用起来又挂了」；缺值这一类解析失败没有这一行，读的人就会去排查一个从没启动的应用。不修，这个假象会持续让人和 agent 白跑一圈。
动手的读者: domain:cli 席，`packages/cli/src/utils/invocation.ts` 的 `isInvocationError()` 识别 oclif 的「expects a value」CLIError，附 cli 单测。
查重: `repo is:issue "expects a value"` 3 命中（#11669、#7635、#21333，都不相关）、`INVOCATION ERROR banner flag` 109（均含已关）；最近邻 #24192 不是本现象。

QA-source: #28927 · cli.dev-boot-contract · observed beside the clauses

## What happens
Since #10181 every parse failure is meant to open with one line, "objectstack: INVOCATION ERROR — … The command never ran: nothing was started and nothing is listening." A flag given without its value skips that banner: `os dev … -d` exits 2 with stdout empty and one stderr line, " ›   Error: Flag --database expects a value". Backgrounded, that is the "booted and died" lookalike the banner exists to prevent (RUNNER environment facts, the `--no-ui` entry).

Measured at framework `7fa9873f` (main, 2026-11-02), twice, from a scratch copy of examples/app-showcase.

## Reproduction
1. From any app dir: `node packages/cli/bin/run.js dev --no-compile -p PORT -d`.
2. **Expected:** exit 2 with the INVOCATION ERROR first line.
3. **Actual:** exit 2, stdout empty, stderr " ›   Error: Flag --database expects a value", no banner.

Controls that do print the banner: `serve --artifact x` (nonexistent flag) and `dev --database-driver memory` (refused value).

## Mechanism (read at 7fa9873f, a guess)
`@oclif/core` `lib/parser/parse.js` (around L137) throws a plain `CLIError` ("Flag --X expects a value"). `isInvocationError()` in `packages/cli/src/utils/invocation.ts` matches only CLIParseError-shaped errors (own `parse` and `showHelp` fields), so this parse failure falls through.
